name: Olmo 3 7B
notes: PARAMS: 7.30B is the safetensors count (7B nominal). KV: 32 * 32 * 128 * 2 * 2 bytes = 524,288 bytes/token = 512 KiB/token. THIS IS THE MOST KV-EXPENSIVE MODEL IN THIS SET PER TOKEN, and it is deliberate: Olmo 3 uses full multi-head attention (32 query heads, 32 KV heads, gqa_ratio 1.0) with no GQA at all. It is 4x the KV per token of Llama 3.1 8B and 2x Llama 3.3 70B. The compensating design choice is the 3:1 sliding-window/global ratio: only 8 of 32 layers are full_attention and the local window is 4096, so at 65536 context roughly a quarter of the layers carry the full sequence and effective KV is about 8/32 of the naive figure. The honest summary for a serving engineer: Olmo 3 chose full MHA plus aggressive local attention instead of GQA plus global attention. Same asymptotic purpose, completely different KV profile, and a different answer to the question of which engine kernels are needed. Also notable for serving: Ai2's Olmo 3 line is the most fully open set in this repo, shipping training data, mid-training mixtures and post-training data alongside the weights.
